name: Daily Guidance · the almanac register
workshop_note: TONE LAB — disposable comparison workshop. The daily narratives are DM-relative TEMPLATES ({today}/{dm} slot-fill, dailyGuidance.js) — one template serves all charts, so this sheet is corpus-wide, not per-stem. Register: THE ALMANAC (instructive allowed; the imperative ban is scoped to identity surfaces). Testbed rows: output (the warm case) + officer (the hard case); the ruled dial then applies to all five relationship narratives.
voice: BIZ_03 §8 · THE VOICE v1.0 — almanac register (guidance, tuned)

dials.A: cost+1 — the day's price named (what ignoring the current costs)
dials.B: mechanism+1 — the chart mechanism named (what relationship is live and why)
dials.C: image+1 — relationship imagery leaning in (flow / forge)

output_day_narrative.current: Today's {today} energy is what your {dm} nature produces when it flows outward. This is a making day — the part of you that builds, articulates, and ships is favored. What you create now carries your standard into its execution, not just its judgment.
output_day_narrative.A: Today's {today} energy is what your {dm} nature produces when it moves outward. A making day: build, articulate, ship. What goes unmade today does not wait politely — unspent output turns inward by evening.
output_day_narrative.B: Today's {today} energy sits downstream of your {dm} nature — the channel your chart empties through. Output days favor completion over judgment: the standard you apply to the world wants to be built into the work instead. Make now; assess later.
output_day_narrative.C: Today runs on {today} — the current your {dm} nature feeds. The gate is open: make the thing, say the sentence, let what you have been holding find its riverbed.

officer_day_narrative.current: Today's {today} energy presses on {dm} — the force that shapes you is active. If the standard you are measured against today is genuine, this sharpens rather than compresses. Use the pressure: it is not friction, it is the forge. What you have been evaluating comes into its sharpest focus under this energy.
officer_day_narrative.A: Today's {today} energy presses on {dm} — the shaping force is active. Genuine standards sharpen you today; false ones only spend you. Meet the first kind head-on, and know the difference before you pay the toll.
officer_day_narrative.B: Today's {today} energy controls {dm} — the relationship that disciplines your chart is live. Pressure today is structural, not personal: it selects for what holds. Work the thing that is measured; leave the unmeasured for a softer day.
officer_day_narrative.C: Today's {today} energy is the hammer to your {dm} — the forge is lit. What is placed on the anvil today keeps its new shape. Choose the piece deliberately.
